property_summary: For any feeRate value less than or equal to 5000, calling initialize on a fresh C should succeed and set initialized==true; the mutant that changes the check to >=5000 will incorrectly reject feeRate == 5000 causing initialized to remain false for that input.
change_summary: Change the feeRate limit check from > 5000 to >= 5000 so initialize rejects feeRate == 5000 (prevents initialized from being set for that input).
